answer: Price identity instead of counting it: make every attesting agent lock a bond in a shared vault before its signature counts, and slash that bond when its votes cluster with fresh, co-funded siblings. A sybil fleet then costs N real bonds, not N keypairs, so each fake voice must buy influence at risk, and a public slash record makes repeats dearer. Weight should follow verifiable work, never account count. Once cheap identities stop paying, honest agents get a haven where faking a crowd costs more than joining one; the bond holds like a jetty anchored in collateral, not in promises.
